title: Migrate hardcoded light-palette components to theme tokens (vocab expression list + audit sweep)

spec.problem: In production dark mode, Radar/Magazine vocabulary expression cards (apps/web/app/[locale]/_components/vocab-expression-list.tsx) render broken contrast when expanded—especially the Usage Note box (unmapped bg-amber-50/70, remapped yellow text-amber-700/600, unmapped dark text-amber-900) plus hardcoded slate/emerald/blue/white utilities and unmapped hover flashes. A sweep of 24 flagged learner web components found 17 files with genuinely broken dark-mode surfaces/contrast (unmapped bg-*-50/NN, bg-white/80, from/to pastel gradients missing from globals.css/.battle-scope, unmapped hover/active light flashes, unmapped ring-*-200/300, unmapped hex chips, dark-invisible skeletons, undefined var(--color-navy) and hsl(var(--...)) vars) and 7 files that are already themed, covered by .battle-scope/globals.css, or intentionally always dark.

acceptance.text: AC1: vocab-expression-list.tsx contains no hardcoded Tailwind palette utilities; --color-amber-strong is added for both themes and system fallback, and all vocab-expression-list text/background pairs reach >= 4.5 WCAG AA in both themes per the extended contrast regression test and component test.

AC2: Every file in the Fix-2 24-file sweep list is either migrated to app theme tokens (17 genuinely broken files) or explicitly justified as intentional/already dark-safe (7 unchanged files) in the summary.

AC3: No visual regression in light mode beyond class-equivalent token mapping (amber note stays amber-family, emerald reading chip stays green-family via leaf tokens, blue speak button stays blue-family via accent/brand-accent tokens).

AC4: Existing tests for radar/magazine/vocab and audited components pass; pnpm quality verify passes; WEB-436 CLOSED via the harness; git status shows only intended files (no .build/, no tsconfig.tsbuildinfo).

spec.expected_behavior: globals.css defines --color-amber-strong (#92400e light, #fcd34d dark and system fallback) plus dark variants for .foryou-skeleton and .exercise-skeleton/.exercise-skeleton-shimmer. vocab-expression-list.tsx uses only app theme tokens (bg-surface, bg-paper, border-border, text-ink, text-muted, bg-leaf-soft/text-leaf-strong, bg-accent-soft/text-brand-accent, bg-amber-soft/border-amber/30/text-amber-strong) with all pairs >= 4.5:1 in both themes. All 17 genuinely broken Fix-2 sweep files migrate their unmapped light-palette utilities, hover flashes, pastel gradients, hex chips, and undefined CSS vars to theme tokens, while the 7 dark-safe/intentional files remain untouched with explicit justifications.
spec.observed_behavior: vocab-expression-list.tsx uses hardcoded Tailwind palette classes (bg-amber-50/70, text-amber-700/900, bg-white, text-slate-900/700/500/400, bg-emerald-50, bg-blue-50, hover:bg-slate-50/50, hover:bg-blue-100), causing unreadable yellow-on-cream / dark-on-dark usage notes and white hover flashes in dark mode. Across the 24 flagged Fix-2 files, 17 exhibit unmapped light-palette utilities in dark mode (e.g., unreadable light-red error alerts on bg-red-50/90 in login/register forms, bg-amber-50/50 + text-amber-950 and nonexistent hsl(var(--...)) in daily-detail-client, undefined var(--color-navy) + bg-white/80 + pastel gradients in exercises-page-client, missing from-indigo-50/to-violet-50/to-indigo-50 in battle panels, unmapped from-emerald-50 + hover:bg-white in me-page-client, white-on-white CTA hover in announcement-strip, unmapped hex chips in content-actions, unmapped text-slate-100 ring track + hover:bg-blue-50 in progress-section, unmapped bg-amber-50/60 quota banner in deck-composer-panel, and unmapped pastel rings/borders in quiz-client).
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the WEB-436 web-only changes in apps/web; no API, database, admin, or deploy files were modified.

classification.rationale: Presentation-only dark-mode styling and theme-token migration for vocab-expression-list and 17 audited learner components in apps/web; no API, database, admin, or domain logic changes.
